blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) documents concerning Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband presented during the House committee on justice impeachment proceedings are “confidential,” a defense witness testified before the Senate impeachment court on Thursday. On the 44th day of the trial, defense counsel Mark Vinluan examined lawyer and accountant Reinel dela Fuente, a former investigator with the AMLC Secretariat’s Compliance and Investigation Group. Vinluan cited AMLC Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura’s April 22 appearance before the justice panel, where he disclosed three categories of documents involving Duterte and Carpio.
